# Reference wire bytes, generated by the upstream protos

`msgsend-uakt-1000000.bin` is a `cosmos.bank.v1beta1.MsgSend` serialised by the **generated**
cosmos protobuf bindings (`cosmpy`), not by a hand-written encoder in this repository.

That distinction is the whole point of the file. The decoder in `cosmos.go` required a varint
for `Coin.amount` and therefore refused every genuine `MsgSend`; nothing caught it because the
only thing checking the claimed conformance was `encodeMsgSend` in this package's own tests,
which encoded the amount as a varint too. The fixture and the decoder shared one assumption
and agreed with each other about a wire format neither matched.

A second hand-written encoder would have been the same assumption a third time. These bytes
are the only artifact that turns the `cosmos-sdk v1beta1` claim in the doc comment from a
sentence into something a test can fail on.

Regenerate with (`pip install cosmpy`):

```python
from pathlib import Path
from cosmpy.protos.cosmos.base.v1beta1.coin_pb2 import Coin
from cosmpy.protos.cosmos.bank.v1beta1.tx_pb2 import MsgSend

message = MsgSend(
    from_address="akash1qqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqq",
    to_address="akash1vvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvv",
    amount=[Coin(denom="uakt", amount="1000000")],
)
raw = message.SerializeToString()
assert len(raw) == 109, len(raw)          # the length the test asserts
Path("msgsend-uakt-1000000.bin").write_bytes(raw)
```

The addresses are placeholders and are not valid bech32; nothing in this path checks them, and the
test asserts the `to_address` verbatim. Changing either address changes the byte count, which is why
the assertion above is there — the test refuses a fixture of a different length rather than silently
checking different bytes than the ones its expectations describe.

`signdoc-akashnet2-msgsend.hex` is a complete Cosmos SDK `tx.v1beta1.SignDoc` generated from the
same bindings. It includes a `TxBody`, `AuthInfo` with sequence 7 and a 200000 gas limit, the
`akashnet-2` chain ID, and account number 42. It is stored as hex so it remains reviewable in a
text diff. Regenerate the bytes with:

```python
from pathlib import Path
from cosmpy.protos.cosmos.tx.v1beta1.tx_pb2 import AuthInfo, Fee, ModeInfo, SignDoc, SignerInfo, TxBody
from cosmpy.protos.cosmos.base.v1beta1.coin_pb2 import Coin
from cosmpy.protos.cosmos.bank.v1beta1.tx_pb2 import MsgSend
from google.protobuf.any_pb2 import Any

msg = MsgSend(
    from_address="akash1qqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqq",
    to_address="akash1vvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvv",
    amount=[Coin(denom="uakt", amount="1000000")],
)
body = TxBody(messages=[Any(type_url="/cosmos.bank.v1beta1.MsgSend", value=msg.SerializeToString())])
auth = AuthInfo(
    signer_infos=[SignerInfo(mode_info=ModeInfo(single=ModeInfo.Single(mode=1)), sequence=7)],
    fee=Fee(gas_limit=200000, amount=[Coin(denom="uakt", amount="1000")]),
)
sign_doc = SignDoc(
    body_bytes=body.SerializeToString(), auth_info_bytes=auth.SerializeToString(),
    chain_id="akashnet-2", account_number=42,
)
Path("signdoc-akashnet2-msgsend.hex").write_text(sign_doc.SerializeToString().hex() + "\n")
```

`signdoc-akashnet2-msgdelegate.hex` is generated the same way with
`cosmos.staking.v1beta1.MsgDelegate`; its validator address is treated as the policy destination.

`signdoc-akashnet2-msgsend-account0-sequence0.hex` is the same shape of `SignDoc` for **account 0
at sequence 0**. Proto3 does not encode a zero scalar, so this document has **no**
`SignDoc.account_number` field and **no** `SignerInfo.sequence` field. That is the only way a real
SignDoc for an account's first transaction can be written, and the parser used to refuse it as
"missing" (found against a live node in regalia#439). Regenerate with:

```python
from pathlib import Path
from cosmpy.protos.cosmos.bank.v1beta1.tx_pb2 import MsgSend
from cosmpy.protos.cosmos.base.v1beta1.coin_pb2 import Coin
from cosmpy.protos.cosmos.tx.v1beta1.tx_pb2 import AuthInfo, Fee, ModeInfo, SignDoc, SignerInfo, TxBody
from cosmpy.protos.cosmos.tx.signing.v1beta1.signing_pb2 import SignMode
from google.protobuf.any_pb2 import Any

msg = Any()
msg.Pack(MsgSend(from_address="akash1qqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqq",
                 to_address="akash1vvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvv",
                 amount=[Coin(denom="uakt", amount="1000000")]), type_url_prefix="/")
auth = AuthInfo(signer_infos=[SignerInfo(mode_info=ModeInfo(single=ModeInfo.Single(mode=SignMode.SIGN_MODE_DIRECT)), sequence=0)],
                fee=Fee(amount=[Coin(denom="uakt", amount="5000")], gas_limit=200000))
doc = SignDoc(body_bytes=TxBody(messages=[msg]).SerializeToString(),
              auth_info_bytes=auth.SerializeToString(), chain_id="akashnet-2", account_number=0)
raw = doc.SerializeToString()
assert len(raw) == 189, len(raw)
Path("signdoc-akashnet2-msgsend-account0-sequence0.hex").write_text(raw.hex() + "\n")
```
